message:
You know that one friend who seems to have a go-bag for every occasion? We’re talking about the gloriously over-prepared person who has snacks for road trips, extra batteries for camping, and enough bottled water to float a small boat. 😄 I used to roll my eyes a bit, but after a recent weekend trip where we faced an unexpected storm, I found myself wishing I had packed even half of what they had. It’s funny how those little moments can shift our perspectives on readiness. 

In the end, preparedness doesn’t have to look perfect; it just has to work for us. What’s your own little tip or trick for staying ready, even if it feels a bit extra sometimes?
